name.ja: ケロロ軍曹プラモコレクション　タママ二等兵
name.en: SERGENT KERORO PLAMO COLLECTION　PRIVATE TAMAMA

ja: アニメ「ケロロ軍曹」より“タママ二等兵”が1/6スケールでプラモデル化 。
首、腕、足など各関節が可動、腕と足はパーツの差し替えで異なるアクションポ－ズも再現可能 。
帽子は上下に可動し、BB戦士との連動する遊びの幅が拡大 。
劇中に登場した様々なガンプラ小物が付属 。
いろプラとシールで設定色を簡単再現。
en: From the anime "Sergeant Keroro ", " Private Tamama" is made into a 1/6 scale plastic model.
Each joint such as the neck, arms, and legs are movable, and different action poses can be recreated by replacing parts of the arms and legs.
The hat can move up and down, expanding the range of play in conjunction with the BB Senshi.
Includes various Gunpla accessories that appeared in the movie.
Easily reproduce the set color with Iropla and Seal.
